provenance.movement_reasoning: Workdays reset Mara's equipment to her office desk while Leon's work spreads across the dining table and studio desk. Meals create a steady kitchen-to-sink/drying flow; washing and putting away restore it. Evening reading, games, calls, and relaxing leave a small layer of sofa and bedside clutter. Trips return the residents' carried essentials to entry storage, jackets, or bags. Mara's tidy-ups restore her systems more reliably than Leon's active-project habits, while cleaning and laundry reset shared household tools.
provenance.persona_reasoning: Two full-time remote workers need distinct work zones, portable personal essentials, and a shared set of kitchen and maintenance objects. The inventory emphasizes realistic movement between a desk, common areas, and occasional trips out while staying within the supplied vocabulary.
